description: Output schema for TiDB EXPLAIN ANALYZE diagnostics tool

<plan_filename>.total_time_ms: float: total wall-clock time of the root operator in milliseconds
<plan_filename>.bottleneck_operator: string: id of the operator with the highest self-execution-time contribution

operators.est_rows: float: estimated rows from the estRows column
operators.act_rows: integer: actual rows from the actRows column
operators.time_ms: float or null: total time from execution info, in milliseconds
operators.self_time_ms: float or null: the operator's own execution overhead excluding time attributable to its direct root-tier child operators; null for non-root operators

issues.type: string: one of lock_contention, mvcc_tombstone, memory_spill, suboptimal_join_order

<operator_id>.index_task_concurrency: int: concurrency of the index_task (default 1 if not stated in execution info)
<operator_id>.table_task_concurrency: int: concurrency from table_task in execution info
<operator_id>.distsql_concurrency: int: distsql_concurrency from child cop_task stats
<operator_id>.max_table_cop_tasks: int: maximum concurrent coprocessor tasks achievable by table_task workers

<comparison_name>.fast_plan: string: filename of the faster plan
<comparison_name>.slow_plan: string: filename of the slower plan
<comparison_name>.root_cause: string: identified root cause type matching a detected issue in the slow plan

lock_contention.resolve_lock_time_ms: float: time spent in lock resolution
lock_contention.resolve_lock_pct: float: percentage of total time spent in lock resolution
lock_contention.backoff_count: int: number of transaction-not-found backoff retries
lock_contention.backoff_total_ms: float: total backoff time in ms

mvcc_tombstone.cop_task_count: int: number of coprocessor tasks dispatched
mvcc_tombstone.max_proc_keys: int: maximum processed keys across coprocessor tasks

suboptimal_join_order.build_side_rows: int: actual rows on the build side
suboptimal_join_order.probe_side_rows: int: actual rows on the probe side
